description: Generate a file that fixes a deterministic finding: 'robots_txt' (unblocks AI crawlers while leaving other rules alone), 'llms_txt' (lists the site's real pages) or 'jsonld' (a script block for one page). Anything we did not measure comes back as TODO rather than a guess, so check needsHumanInput before committing. Pass exactly one of report_id or domain_id. Free: does not use a credit.

domain_id.description: Domain ID, for a site-scoped artifact

report_id.description: Report ID, for a page-scoped artifact

name: get_artifact
title: Get a file to commit
